statement: Perfect closures of effective global and henselian-global fields and all finite towers admit complete ordinary factorization division-index radical and hermitian-isometry arithmetic
depends_on: C:global-function-field-arithmetic; C:henselian-global-field-arithmetic; C:global-function-central-simple-algorithms; C:henselian-central-simple-algorithms; C:global-function-hermitian-isometry; C:henselian-hermitian-isometry; BayerFluckigerLenstra1990Cor1.4; GilleSzamuely2006Prop4.5.13
notes: Finite-stage factorization strips inseparable powers; a prime-to-p index stopping certificate yields actual division matrices. Odd-degree descent reflects actual hermitian isometry to one stage.

statement: Complete ordinary canonical split WG for finite algebras and coherent-local henselizations over finite extensions of the explicit perfect closures
notes: Actual Hom images and radical quotients, actual lifts, literal indecomposable and Gram-pair coordinates, and finite tensor and exterior algorithms close the previously retained perfect-field arithmetic gates.

statement: Perfect closures of Fq(t) and its t-adic henselian field give explicit nonC1 field and nonfield families with value group Z[1/p]
notes: A four-variable anisotropic quadratic form survives because 1 is not in 2 Z[1/p]. The perfect global field is nonhenselian for its natural valuation; the other is henselian. Perfectness excludes the earlier discretely valued fields.
